title: git.md says GitHub CI is run by hand on the runners, but kb.yml runs on every push on GitHub's hosted runners
goal: kb/_self/git.md says what each CI does as it is: GitLab's jobs are manual and run on the project's own runners, while .github/workflows/kb.yml runs on every push to any branch or tag on GitHub's hosted runners; neither is described as the other.

run: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/git.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); sys.exit(1 if any('run by hand on the runners' in l and 'kb.yml' in l.split('run by hand on the runners',1)[1][:120] for l in t.splitlines()) else 0)
